name: verify-delivery
description: Require observed detachment, a new frame and an actual radio contact receipt.

request_format.encoding: JSON object passed as the --request argument
request_format.fields: package_id and a real inbox receipt_message_id. Omit post_drop_frame_id to acquire a fresh post-contact frame; then call again with the resulting post_drop_frame_id to check actual receiving-site visibility and the payload ledger. Arbitrary actuator/receipt objects are not accepted.

completion.poll: status_flag with the returned request ID
